title: JEPA v17 Cascade Deploy Gate — v18 Architecture Spec (Gate Closed)
v18_rationale: Pairwise RankNet covers all (correct, incorrect) pairs but treats each pair independently; when two pairs are too similar, the model can hedge by predicting P=0.5 for each without incurring large loss. Listwise LambdaRank optimises a global ranking of ALL steps for a question simultaneously using NDCG as the surrogate metric — this is the true evaluation objective (AUC = fraction of correctly ordered pairs across the full ranking), so listwise loss directly minimises what we measure.
v18_data_requirement: Need >= 5 steps per question for listwise loss to provide a meaningful ranking signal; FoVer v1 provides only 2 steps per question (1 correct + 1 synthetic incorrect).
v18_data_gap: Exp 712 FoVer v2 PDDL would provide 5+ steps per question via formal PDDL plan enumeration, resolving the data gap for listwise training.
